description: The pie chart visually represents the time distribution between two key components of the Paper Copilot system: “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” The chart is divided into two segments, with the larger orange segment labeled “Reduction” accounting for 60.9 seconds (69.92% of the total time), and the smaller blue segment labeled “Efficient deployment” representing 26.2 seconds. The “Reduction” slice is slightly exploded outward for emphasis, and both slices include their respective time values and, in the case of “Reduction,” the percentage of total time. The chart effectively highlights that the majority of processing time is consumed by the reduction phase, while efficient deployment constitutes a smaller but significant portion. No legend is present, as the labels are directly placed next to their corresponding slices.
